title: bro wait --json
description: {verdict, refs, unsettled?} — the dep-plane watcher's terminal document (emit() in packages/cli/src/commands/wait.ts). Top-level verdict is the exit code word; `unsettled` rides only on the timeout arm. Each refs entry carries the settled verdict plus annotation — `source` is always present (derived from the plane, not the settle); `waiting` marks a ref still open at timeout.

unsettled.description: the still-open ref args — emitted only when the bound held (verdict: timeout)
